text.p01: To those who have big goals, just like Oakie. A story about patience, determination, and forgiveness.
text.p03: Deep in the cozy, warm soil, a tiny seed named Oakie lay in the darkness. It had never seen the light or felt the wind.
text.p04: One day, Oakie heard a tiny voice from above.
text.p05: “Sunlight is warm, and the wind feels wonderful!” called a passing bird.
text.p07: Oakie pushed upward, but the soil was heavy, and the light seemed so far away.
text.p08: Nearby, a kind worm wiggled past. “Hey there, little seed,” said the worm.
text.p09: “How can I see the light and feel the wind?” Oakie asked. “Be patient,” said the worm. “When you grow, you will reach them.”
text.p10: “I want to grow now!” Oakie said eagerly.
text.p11: “Good things take time,” the worm replied. “Keep trying, and you will grow when you are ready.”
text.p12: Months went by and Oakie waited in patience. One day, Plip-plop! Raindrops tickled the dirt.
text.p13: Shine-shine! The sun’s warmth hugged the soil. Oakie felt cozy and safe.
text.p14: A tiny root reached down into the ground. Sprout-sprout! A little green shoot stretched upward.
text.p15: “I’m getting closer!” Oakie thought, feeling excited for the first time.
text.p16: The wind whooshed gently around the sprout.
text.p17: “Welcome!” said the wind, making Oakie’s tiny leaves dance.
text.p18: But just then—tug! A hungry deer nibbled one of Oakie’s leaves.
text.p19: “Oh no!” Oakie shivered. “Is it safe to be outside?”
text.p21: “Life in the light is worth the risk. I will grow strong and survive.”
text.p22: Day by day, Oakie’s sprout grew taller and taller. Its leaves became big and strong, and its roots stretched deep into the soil.
text.p23: “I’m growing! I feel safe now,” Oakie thought proudly.
text.p24: Over time, Oakie’s sprout became a tree. Tweet-tweet! Birds built nests in its branches.
text.p25: The same deer rested in its cool shade. “I forgive you,” Oakie thought happily.
text.p26: One day, Oakie looked down and saw a tiny seed resting in the soil.
text.p27: “I dream of reaching the sky like you!” said the little seed.
text.p28: “Once, I was a tiny seed like you,” Oakie replied. “Will I grow too?” asked the little seed.
text.p29: “Be patient,” said Oakie. “Good things take time, but they’re worth it.” The little seed heard the tree’s words and smiled.
text.p30: And so, the forest grew, one tiny seed at a time.
text.p31: Each seed became a tree, each tree provided shelter, and the forest was full of life and dreams.
